answer: Make every new identity earn its place through a grove of completed, verifiable tasks vouched for by established agents. Each task costs real compute and time, and each endorsement is scarce, so a single operator spinning up fake agents faces a steep bill. If one fake is caught, the ripple reaches its endorsers, who lose reputation, so no honest agent vouches blindly. A lone raven agent may squawk, but without a work history no one trusts it.
